readings: Considering only tracks with Track.Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804, compute for each media type (by name) the average of the per-track ratio Bytes ÷ Milliseconds. Then return the simple (unweighted) average of these per-media-type averages, unrounded.

Considering only tracks with Track.Bytes greater than or equal to 10,323,804 (so a track with exactly 10,323,804 bytes is included), compute for each media type (by name) the average of the per-track ratio Bytes ÷ Milliseconds. Then return the simple (unweighted) average of these per-media-type averages, unrounded.
queries: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name)

SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.Name
)
